title: 形容词的三大岗位与语序
objective: 今天只学一个点：形容词站哪儿、几个一起怎么排。形容词是给名词加装饰的词，它有三个岗位：站在名词前的定语（a lovely sign）、站在系动词后的表语（The shop is bright.）、站在宾语后面补充说明的宾补（make the window clean）。多个形容词一起站名词前时按口诀排队：限定描绘大长高，形状年龄和新老，颜色国籍出材料，作用类别往后靠。还有一条铁律：the / my / this / three 这类限定词永远站在形容词前面。
goal: 能正确排列多个形容词（a lovely little brown rabbit）。

sentences.en: The rabbit opens Carrot Home early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 清晨，兔子很早就开门营业。

sentences.en: A lovely little brown sign hangs over the door.
sentences.zh: 一块可爱的小棕色招牌挂在门上方。
sentences.note: 定语：lovely little brown 一串形容词站名词 sign 前——顺序「描绘 → 大小 → 颜色」

sentences.en: The rabbit puts a round wooden table near the window.
sentences.zh: 兔子把一张圆木桌放在窗边。
sentences.note: 语序：round（形状）站 wooden（材料）前——形状年龄和新老，颜色国籍出材料

sentences.en: Fresh orange carrots lie on the brown shelf.
sentences.zh: 新鲜的橙色胡萝卜摆在棕色架子上。

sentences.en: The wolf carries two big boxes into the little shop.
sentences.zh: 狼把两个大箱子搬进小店。

sentences.en: The little shop is bright and warm.
sentences.zh: 小店明亮又温暖。
sentences.note: 表语：bright and warm 站系动词 is 后，说明主语 the little shop

sentences.en: The new table looks strong and clean.
sentences.zh: 新桌子看起来又结实又干净。

sentences.en: The carrots taste delicious and fresh.
sentences.zh: 胡萝卜尝起来又美味又新鲜。

sentences.en: The brown sign seems lovely from the street.
sentences.zh: 从街上望过去，棕色招牌很好看。

sentences.en: The wolf is happy with the warm little shop.
sentences.zh: 狼对这间温暖的小店很满意。

sentences.en: The rabbit makes the window clean and bright.
sentences.zh: 兔子把窗户擦得干净又明亮。
sentences.note: 宾补：clean and bright 站宾语 the window 后面补充说明它——不说 makes clean the window

sentences.en: The wolf finds the little shop warm and friendly.
sentences.zh: 狼觉得这间小店温暖又友好。

sentences.en: The wolf carries my three lovely little brown boxes to the shelf.
sentences.zh: 狼把我那三个可爱的小棕色箱子搬到架子上。
sentences.note: 语序：my three（限定）永远在 lovely little brown（形容词）前面——限定词 + 形容词 + 名词

sentences.en: The happy wolf stays for a bowl of hot soup.
sentences.zh: 开心的狼留下来喝了一碗热汤。

sentences.en: The little shop is ready for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 小店已经为明天做好了准备。

vocab.example: A lovely little brown sign hangs over the door.
The rabbit puts a round wooden table near the window.
The rabbit puts a round wooden table near the window.
Fresh orange carrots lie on the brown shelf.
Fresh orange carrots lie on the brown shelf.
The wolf carries my three lovely little brown boxes to the shelf.
The brown sign seems lovely from the street.
The happy wolf stays for a bowl of hot soup.
Fresh orange carrots lie on the brown shelf.
The little shop is bright and warm.

notes.rule:
**规则**：形容词有三个岗位。**定语**：站名词前修饰它——`a lovely sign`（多个定语按口诀排队）；**表语**：站系动词（is / look / taste / seem 这类）后说明主语——`The little shop is bright.`；**宾补**：站宾语后面补充说明宾语——`make the window clean`、`find the shop warm`（不说 makes clean the window）。**多个形容词的顺序口诀**：**限定描绘大长高，形状年龄和新老，颜色国籍出材料，作用类别往后靠**——`a lovely little brown rabbit`：lovely（描绘）→ little（大小）→ brown（颜色）。**限定词在形容词前**：the / my / this / three 这类限定词永远站形容词前面，名词短语的完整顺序是「**限定词 + 形容词 + 名词**」——`my three lovely little brown boxes`。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `a lovely little brown rabbit` —— 描绘 → 大小 → 颜色，正好落在口诀顺序上
❌ `a brown little lovely rabbit` —— 颜色、大小、描绘乱排队，英语读者会皱眉
✅ `my three big red carrots` —— 限定词（my three）永远在形容词（big red）前面

practice.stem: 「The little shop is bright and warm.」中 bright and warm 是什么岗位？
options: 表语，站系动词后说明主语
宾补，站宾语后补充说明
practice.explanation: **B**。bright and warm 站在系动词 is 后面，说明主语 the little shop——表语岗位；定语站名词前，宾补站宾语后。

practice.stem: 下面哪个名词短语的形容词顺序正确（按口诀）？
practice.explanation: **C**。口诀顺序「描绘 → 大小 → 颜色」：lovely（描绘）→ little（大小）→ brown（颜色），正好是 a lovely little brown rabbit。

practice.template: The rabbit keeps a wooden round box. → The rabbit keeps a ______ ______ box.
practice.explanation: **round；wooden**。口诀「形状年龄和新老，颜色国籍出材料」：round（形状）排在 wooden（材料）前面。

practice.template: The wolf buys big three carrots. → The wolf buys ______ ______ carrots.
practice.explanation: **three；big**。限定词永远站形容词前面：three（数量限定）+ big（形容词）+ carrots（名词）。

practice.template: The rabbit sees a brown old round sign. → The rabbit sees a ______ ______ ______ sign.
practice.explanation: **round；old；brown**。按口诀排队：round（形状）→ old（年龄）→ brown（颜色）。

practice.prompt: 从 lovely / little / round / brown / wooden 中任选三个形容词，按口诀顺序和一个名词组成名词短语，再用它写一个完整句子；另写一个「主 + 系 + 表」句描述小店（共 2 句）。
sample: The rabbit keeps a lovely little brown box.
The little shop is bright and warm.

quiz.stem: 「A lovely little brown sign hangs over the door.」中 lovely little brown 是什么岗位？
quiz.explanation: **B**。lovely little brown 站在名词 sign 前面修饰它——定语岗位。

quiz.stem: 形容词站在系动词后说明主语，这个岗位叫 ______。
quiz.explanation: **表语**。表语站系动词后说明主语（The little shop is bright.）；定语站名词前，宾补站宾语后。

quiz.stem: 「我那三个可爱的棕色小箱子」顺序正确的是：
options: my three brown lovely little boxes
my three lovely little brown boxes
my lovely three little brown boxes
three my lovely little brown boxes
quiz.explanation: **B**。限定词（my three）永远在形容词前面，形容词按「描绘 → 大小 → 颜色」排队：my three lovely little brown boxes。

quiz.stem: 形容词顺序口诀第一环是「______描绘大长高」——the / my / this 这类词排最前。
quiz.explanation: **限定**。口诀第一环「限定描绘大长高」——the / my / this 这类限定词排最前。

quiz.stem: 「The shop will open tomorrow.」中 will 后面接动词的什么形式？（复习 U03L24：将来表达四件套）
quiz.explanation: **A**。will + 动词原形（U03L24）：will open，will 后面不接过去式或 -ing。

quiz.stem: 现在完成时 = have / has + done：The wolf ______ (wash) all the bowls already.（复习 U03L22：现在完成时）
quiz.explanation: **has washed**。现在完成时 = have / has + done：主语 the wolf 是第三人称单数用 has，wash 的过去分词是 washed（U03L22）。

title: 比较级与最高级：变化规则
objective: 今天只学一个点：形容词的比较级、最高级怎么变。要说「更……」和「最……」，英语靠形容词自己变形：单音节和部分双音节加 `-er / -est`（big → bigger → biggest），音节多的形容词用 `more / most`（important → more important），还有几个必须背的不规则变化（good → better → best）。本课只练形式；怎么拿这些形式做比较（than / as … as / the + 最高级 + 范围）是下一课 U04L27 的事。
goal: 能造出任意常见形容词的比较级、最高级形式。

sentences.en: The rabbit goes to the market with the wolf.
sentences.zh: 兔子和狼一起去市场。

sentences.en: Carrot Home needs a bigger table and a longer shelf.
sentences.zh: Carrot Home 需要一张更大的桌子和一条更长的架子。
sentences.note: 加 -er：单音节比较级——big 双写 g 再加 -er，long 直接加 -er

sentences.en: Mother sheep sells the cheapest and sweetest carrots.
sentences.zh: 绵羊妈妈卖的胡萝卜最便宜、最甜。
sentences.note: 加 -est：最高级形式——cheap、sweet 都直接加 -est

sentences.en: The wolf picks a nicer wooden box for his bread.
sentences.zh: 狼给他的面包挑了一个更漂亮的木盒。

sentences.en: The rabbit wants a lighter bag and a smaller sign.
sentences.zh: 兔子想要一个更轻的袋子和一块更小的招牌。

sentences.en: The little sheep carries a heavy bag, and the rabbit takes a heavier one.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊背着沉袋子，兔子拿了一个更沉的。
sentences.note: 辅音 + y 变 -ier：heavy → heavier，不用 heavyer

sentences.en: The rabbit thinks about the more expensive wooden table.
sentences.zh: 兔子在考虑那张更贵的木桌。
sentences.note: more + 原级：音节多的形容词——expensive → more expensive，不说 expensiver

sentences.en: The rabbit chooses the more useful shelf for the little shop.
sentences.zh: 兔子为小店挑了更实用的架子。

sentences.en: Mother sheep cooks the most delicious soup.
sentences.zh: 绵羊妈妈煮出最美味的汤。

sentences.en: The wolf says better soup brings more customers.
sentences.zh: 狼说更好的汤会带来更多顾客。
sentences.note: 不规则：good → better，many / much → more——没有规律，必须背

sentences.en: The weather is worse today, but the market is busy.
sentences.zh: 今天天气更差，但市场很忙。

sentences.en: The little sheep gets the best apples for the shop.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊为店里挑了最好的苹果。

sentences.en: The rabbit writes every new form on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 兔子把每个新形式写在一张纸上。

sentences.en: The wolf helps to carry the heavy boxes home.
sentences.zh: 狼帮忙把沉箱子搬回家。

sentences.en: The two friends walk home with their new things.
sentences.zh: 两个朋友带着新东西走回家。

vocab.example: The rabbit goes to the market with the wolf.
Mother sheep sells the cheapest and sweetest carrots.
The little sheep carries a heavy bag, and the rabbit takes a heavier one.
The rabbit thinks about the more expensive wooden table.
The rabbit chooses the more useful shelf for the little shop.
The wolf picks a nicer wooden box for his bread.

vocab.meaning: 好的（比较级 better / 最高级 best）
vocab.example: The wolf says better soup brings more customers.

vocab.meaning: 坏的（比较级 worse / 最高级 worst）
vocab.example: The weather is worse today, but the market is busy.
The little sheep gets the best apples for the shop.
The rabbit writes every new form on a piece of paper.

notes.rule:
**规则**：比较级（更……）和最高级（最……）有两种变法。**加 -er / -est**：单音节和部分双音节（big → bigger → biggest、long → longer → longest），注意三个拼写关：以 e 结尾加 -r / -st（nice → nicer → nicest）；「辅音 + y」把 y 变 i 再加 -ier / -iest（heavy → heavier → heaviest）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音（big → bigger → biggest）。**用 more / most**：音节多的形容词不加 -er，前面加 more / most（important → more important → most important、expensive → more expensive）——判断看**音节数**，不看词长。**双音节怎么判**：双音节 -y / -er / -le / -ow 结尾多加 -er / -est，其余双音节与多音节用 more / most；拿不准时用 more / most 总是安全。**不规则变化必须背**：good → better → best、bad → worse → worst、many / much → more → most、little → less → least。比较的用法（than / as … as / the + 最高级 + 范围）见 U04L27。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `big → bigger → biggest` —— 单音节，双写 g 再加 -er / -est
❌ `big → biger / more bigger` —— biger 少双写一个 g；more bigger 是「-er 和 more 双重叠加」，都错
✅ `important → more important → most important` —— 音节多，用 more / most

practice.stem: 「辅音 + y」结尾的 happy，比较级是哪个？
practice.explanation: **A**。「辅音 + y」结尾要 y 变 i 再加 -er：happy → happier，不是 happyer，也不用 more。

practice.stem: 下面哪个形容词的比较级要用 more + 原级？
practice.explanation: **C**。important 音节多，比较级用 more + 原级；big / happy / nice 都是短词加 -er（bigger / happier / nicer）。

practice.template: The rabbit keeps a big box. → The rabbit keeps a ______ box.
practice.explanation: **bigger**。单音节 big 重读闭音节双写末尾 g 再加 -er。

practice.template: The soup is useful. → The soup is ______.
practice.explanation: **more useful**。useful 音节多，比较级用 more + 原级，不说 usefuller。

practice.template: This bread is bad. → This bread is ______.
practice.explanation: **worse**。bad 的比较级不规则：bad → worse → worst，必须背。

practice.prompt: 写出 heavy / useful / good 的比较级与最高级，再用其中任意两个比较级各造一句（共 2 句）。
sample: heavy → heavier → heaviest
useful → more useful → most useful
good → better → best
practice.criteria: 变化对即可；造句合理即可

quiz.stem: big 是单音节、要双写末尾辅音，它的最高级是 ______。
quiz.explanation: **biggest**。双写末尾 g 再加 -est：big → bigger → biggest。

quiz.stem: 哪组形式全部正确？
quiz.explanation: **B**。「辅音 + y」变 -ier / -iest：happy → happier → happiest；A、D 的 happyer 少变 y，C 的 more happy 是错的。

quiz.stem: good 的最高级是 ______。
quiz.explanation: **best**。good 的不规则变化：good → better → best。

quiz.stem:
不规则变化「bad → ______ → worst」的空格是：
- A. badder
- B. worst
- C. worse
- D. more bad
quiz.explanation: **C**。bad → worse → worst，不规则，必须背。

quiz.stem: 「The little shop is bright and warm.」中 bright and warm 站在什么位置？（复习 U04L25：形容词的三大岗位与语序）
quiz.explanation: **B**。bright and warm 站系动词 is 后说明主语——表语岗位（U04L25）。

quiz.stem: 「狼昨天来过店里。」= The wolf ______ the shop yesterday.（复习 U03L23：一般过去时 vs 现在完成时）
quiz.explanation: **visited（或 came to）**。yesterday 是过去时间标志，事情已结束用一般过去时（U03L23）。

title: 三大比较结构
objective: 今天只学一个点：三大比较结构。上一课把形式备齐（bigger / best），今天学会用：① as + 原级 + as（和……一样）与 not as + 原级 + as（不如）；② 比较级 + than（两者相比），比较级前还能加 much（……得多）或 a little（……一点）；③ the + 最高级 + 范围（三者及以上最……，范围用 of / in 引出）。纪律只有一条：两者比较用比较级，三者及以上才用最高级。
goal: 能比较两样东西（This carrot is bigger than that one.）。

sentences.en: The rabbit and the wolf walk to Mother sheep's stall.
sentences.zh: 兔子和狼走到绵羊妈妈的摊位。

sentences.en: This carrot is bigger than that one.
sentences.zh: 这根胡萝卜比那根大。
sentences.note: 比较级 + than：两者相比——bigger 后用 than 引出比较对象

sentences.en: The rabbit compares the two bags and takes the heavier one.
sentences.zh: 兔子比较了两个袋子，拿了更沉的那个。

sentences.en: Mother sheep's soup is much better than the wolf's.
sentences.zh: 绵羊妈妈的汤比狼的好得多。
sentences.note: much 修饰比较级：much better（好得多）——very 不修饰比较级

sentences.en: The price here is a little lower than last week.
sentences.zh: 这里的价格比上周低一点。

sentences.en: The rabbit's carrots are as sweet as Mother sheep's.
sentences.zh: 兔子的胡萝卜和绵羊妈妈的一样甜。
sentences.note: as + 原级 + as：和……一样——中间用原级 sweet，不放比较级

sentences.en: The little sheep is not as tall as the wolf.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊不如狼高。
sentences.note: not as + 原级 + as：不如……——中间同样用原级 tall

sentences.en: The wolf's soup is not as good as the rabbit's.
sentences.zh: 狼的汤不如兔子的好。

sentences.en: The wolf works as hard as the rabbit now.
sentences.zh: 狼现在干得和兔子一样卖力。

sentences.en: The little shop is not as busy as the market.
sentences.zh: 小店不如市场热闹。

sentences.en: Mother sheep has the cheapest carrots of all.
sentences.zh: 绵羊妈妈的胡萝卜是所有货里最便宜的。
sentences.note: the + 最高级 + 范围：the cheapest of all——三者及以上用最高级，范围用 of 引出

sentences.en: Carrot Home has the longest shelf in town.
sentences.zh: Carrot Home 有镇上最长的架子。

sentences.en: The rabbit's soup is the best in the market.
sentences.zh: 兔子的汤是市场里最好的。

sentences.en: The new things cost half the money.
sentences.zh: 新东西只花了一半的钱。

sentences.en: The wolf walks home on the other side of the street.
sentences.zh: 狼沿着街道另一边走回家。

vocab.example: The rabbit and the wolf walk to Mother sheep's stall.
This carrot is bigger than that one.
The rabbit compares the two bags and takes the heavier one.
The price here is a little lower than last week.
Carrot Home has the longest shelf in town.
The new things cost half the money.
The new things cost half the money.
The wolf walks home on the other side of the street.
Mother sheep has the cheapest carrots of all.
The new things cost half the money.

notes.rule:
**规则**：三大比较结构。① **as + 原级 + as**（和……一样）：`The rabbit is as fast as the wolf.`；否定式 **not as / so + 原级 + as**（不如）：`The carrot is not as big as that one.`——两种都**必须用原级**，中间不放比较级。② **比较级 + than**（两者相比）：`The wolf runs faster than the rabbit.`，比较级前可以加 **much**（……得多）或 **a little**（……一点）：`much better`、`a little lower`——注意 very 修饰原级，**不修饰比较级**。③ **the + 最高级 + 范围**（三者及以上最……）：`The rabbit is the fastest of all.`，范围用 **of**（of the three / of all）或 **in**（in the market / in town）引出。纪律：**两者比较用比较级，三者及以上才用最高级**——the faster of the two、the fastest of the three。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The carrot is as sweet as that one.` —— as + 原级 + as，中间用原级 sweet
❌ `The carrot is as sweeter as that one.` —— as … as 中间不能放比较级
✅ `much better / a little lower` —— 比较级前加 much（得多）或 a little（一点），不说 very better

practice.stem: 「This carrot is bigger than that one.」用的是哪个比较结构？
practice.explanation: **B**。bigger 是比较级，后接 than 引出比较对象——「比较级 + than」；as … as 中间放原级，the + 最高级要带范围。

practice.stem: 下面哪句正确？
options: The soup is as better as that one.
The soup is much better than that one.
The soup is very better than that one.
The soup is more better than that one.
practice.explanation: **B**。比较级前用 much（……得多）：much better；A 的 as … as 中间不能放比较级，C 的 very 不修饰比较级，D 的 more better 是双重比较。

practice.template: The rabbit is faster than the wolf.（改成「和……一样」）→ The rabbit is ______ ______ ______ the wolf.
practice.explanation: **as；fast；as**。「和……一样」= as + 原级 + as：faster 还原成原级 fast，前后各一个 as。

practice.template: Mother sheep's soup is better than the wolf's. → Mother sheep's soup is ______ better than the wolf's.
practice.explanation: **much（或 even / far / a little）**。much 修饰比较级（much better）；even / far / a little 站比较级前也合语法；very 修饰原级，不说 very better。

practice.template: The rabbit's soup is good.（三者比较）→ The rabbit's soup is ______ in the market.
practice.explanation: **the best**。三者比较用「the + 最高级 + 范围」：good 的最高级是不规则的 best，前面要带 the。

practice.prompt: 用「比较级 + than」「as … as」「the + 最高级 + 范围」三种结构各写一句，比较兔子店和狼的东西（共 3 句）。
sample: This carrot is bigger than that one.
The rabbit's soup is as good as the wolf's.
Carrot Home has the longest shelf in town.

quiz.stem: 「The little sheep is not as tall as the wolf.」表示：
quiz.explanation: **C**。not as + 原级 + as 表示「不如」：小绵羊不如狼高。

quiz.stem: the + 最高级 + ______表示「最……」，这个成分用 of / in 引出。
quiz.explanation: **范围**。「the + 最高级 + 范围」——范围用 of（of all / of the three）或 in（in town / in the market）引出。

quiz.stem: 比较级前可以加 much 或 a little，下面哪个不能加在比较级前？
quiz.explanation: **C**。very 修饰原级，不修饰比较级；much（得多）、a little（一点）、even（甚至）都能站在比较级前。

quiz.stem: 「这根胡萝卜和那根一样大」= This carrot is as ______ as that one.
quiz.explanation: **big**。「和……一样大」= as big as——as … as 中间用原级，不写 as bigger as。

quiz.stem: heavy 的比较级是哪个？（复习 U04L26：比较级与最高级的变化规则）
quiz.explanation: **B**。「辅音 + y」变 -ier：heavy → heavier（U04L26）；heavyer 不变 y，heaviest 是最高级。

quiz.stem: 「我打算明天去市场。」= I am ______ to go to the market tomorrow.（复习 U03L24：将来表达四件套）
quiz.explanation: **going**。「be going to + 动词原形」表计划（U03L24）：I am going to go to the market tomorrow.

title: 副词：站位公式
objective: 今天只学一个点：副词站哪儿。副词是修饰的万金油：修饰动词（run quickly）、修饰形容词（very quick）、修饰副词（very quickly），甚至修饰整句。分工先分清：修饰名词用形容词，修饰其余用副词。站位记一个公式：频度副词「系后实前」——句子里有系动词就站它后面（is always busy），是实义动词就站动词前面（always helps）。再防两个陷阱：hard 是「努力地」、hardly 是「几乎不」；very 修饰原级（very fast），不修饰比较级。
goal: 能把副词放在正确位置，不写 works very hardly。

sentences.en: The rabbit opens Carrot Home at nine every morning.
sentences.zh: 兔子每天早上九点开 Carrot Home 的门。

sentences.en: The little shop is always busy on Monday.
sentences.zh: 小店一到周一总是很忙。
sentences.note: 系后：频度副词 always 站系动词 is 后面——公式「系后」

sentences.en: The quick wolf walks in and smiles at everyone.
sentences.zh: 手脚快的狼走进来，对大家笑。
sentences.note: 分工：quick 是形容词，站名词 wolf 前——修饰名词用形容词，修饰动词才用副词

sentences.en: The busy rabbit works hard from morning to night.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的兔子从早到晚努力干活。
sentences.note: 陷阱：work hard = 努力地——hardly 是「几乎不」，不写 works very hardly

sentences.en: The rabbit always helps every customer with a smile.
sentences.zh: 兔子总是笑着招待每位顾客。
sentences.note: 实前：频度副词 always 站实义动词 helps 前面——公式「实前」

sentences.en: The wolf often comes to the shop after work.
sentences.zh: 狼经常下班后来店里。

sentences.en: The little sheep usually takes the soup home.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊通常把汤带回家。

sentences.en: The hungry wolf eats very fast.
sentences.zh: 饿狼吃得飞快。
sentences.note: very fast：very 修饰原级 fast——fast 兼作副词，不说 very faster

sentences.en: The wolf hardly sleeps on busy days.
sentences.zh: 狼忙起来几乎不睡觉。

sentences.en: The shop never closes early on Monday.
sentences.zh: 小店周一从不早关门。

sentences.en: The wolf usually goes home at six.
sentences.zh: 狼通常六点回家。

sentences.en: The rabbit counts the money and writes it down.
sentences.zh: 兔子把钱数一遍记下来。

sentences.en: The shop is quiet and warm at night.
sentences.zh: 夜里小店安静又温暖。

sentences.en: The tired rabbit walks home slowly.
sentences.zh: 疲累的兔子慢慢走回家。

sentences.en: The wolf says he will help again tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 狼说他明天还会来帮忙。

vocab.example: The rabbit always helps every customer with a smile.
The wolf often comes to the shop after work.
The little sheep usually takes the soup home.
The shop never closes early on Monday.
The wolf hardly sleeps on busy days.
The hungry wolf eats very fast.
The shop never closes early on Monday.
The tired rabbit walks home slowly.
The little shop is always busy on Monday.
The tired rabbit walks home slowly.

notes.rule:
**规则**：副词与形容词先分工：**修饰名词用形容词**（`a quick rabbit`、`The rabbit is quick.`），**修饰动词 / 形容词 / 副词 / 整句用副词**（`The rabbit runs quickly.`、`very quick`、`very quickly`）。**频度副词站位公式「系后实前」**：句子里有 be 这类系动词，always / often / usually / never 站**系动词后面**（`The shop is always busy.`）；句子是实义动词，站**动词前面**（`The rabbit always helps.`）；有助动词 / 情态动词站它们**后面**（`The wolf can never catch it.`）。**陷阱一**：hard 是「努力地」（`work hard`），hardly 是「几乎不」（`It hardly rains.`），不写 works very hardly；**陷阱二**：very 修饰**原级**（`very fast`），不修饰比较级（不说 very faster，要说 much faster——much 的完整分工见 U04L29）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The shop is always busy. / The rabbit always helps.` —— 系后实前：be 后、实义动词前
❌ `The rabbit eats always carrots.` —— 频度副词不站实义动词后面，要站它前面
✅ `The rabbit works hard and runs very fast.` —— hard 是努力地，very 修饰原级 fast

practice.stem: 「The quick wolf walks in.」中 quick 是什么词？
practice.explanation: **B**。quick 是形容词，站名词 wolf 前面修饰它；修饰动词要用副词 quickly。

practice.stem: 下面哪句的频度副词站位正确？
practice.explanation: **B**。「系后实前」：eats 是实义动词，always 站它前面——The rabbit always eats carrots.；A 站实义动词后，C 站名词前，都错。

practice.template: The shop is busy on Monday.（加上 always）→ The shop ______ busy on Monday.
practice.explanation: **is always**。系后：频度副词站系动词 is 后面——The shop is always busy on Monday.

practice.template: The rabbit helps every customer.（加上 always）→ The rabbit ______ every customer.
hints: 频度副词·站实义动词前
practice.explanation: **always helps**。实前：频度副词站实义动词 helps 前面——The rabbit always helps every customer.

practice.template: The rabbit works hard all day.（换成「几乎不工作」）→ The rabbit ______ all day.
practice.explanation: **hardly works**。「几乎不工作」用否定副词 hardly + 动词——hardly 不是「努力地」，努力地用 hard。

practice.prompt: 用 always / often / never 各写一句：至少一句含系动词（用「系后」站位），至少一句含实义动词（用「实前」站位），再写一句用上 hard 或 hardly（共 3 句）。
sample: The shop is always busy.
The wolf often comes to the shop.
The rabbit hardly works all day.

quiz.stem: 「The rabbit always helps every customer.」中 always 的位置是：
quiz.explanation: **A**。系后实前：helps 是实义动词，always 站它前面。

quiz.stem: hard 是「努力地」，hardly 是「______」。
quiz.explanation: **几乎不**。hardly 是否定副词「几乎不」（The wolf hardly sleeps.），不是 hard 的「努力地」。

quiz.stem: 哪句正确？
quiz.explanation: **B**。very 修饰原级；努力地是 hard，不说 very hardly；副词站位也不是 C、D 那样。

quiz.stem: very 修饰原级：very ______（快），不说 very faster。
quiz.explanation: **fast**。very 修饰原级 fast（very fast）；修饰比较级要用 much（much faster）。

quiz.stem: 「This carrot is bigger than that one.」用的是哪个比较结构？（复习 U04L27：三大比较结构）
quiz.explanation: **B**。bigger 是比较级 + than 引出比较对象——「比较级 + than」（U04L27）。

quiz.stem: 名词短语 my three lovely little brown boxes 里，______ 词永远站形容词前面。（复习 U04L25：形容词的三大岗位与语序）
quiz.explanation: **限定**。限定词（my three）永远站形容词（lovely little brown）前面：限定词 + 形容词 + 名词（U04L25）。

title: 副词进阶：分类与句子副词
objective: 今天只学一个点：副词按语义分类、按类别站位。方式副词（carefully）站动词后、句末最稳；程度副词（very）站被修饰词前；时间副词（finally）多站句末或句首；地点副词（outside）站动词后 / 句末；频度副词站位公式见 U04L28。句子副词（Luckily、Finally）不修饰某个词，而是给整句定调——站句首、加逗号。最后钉死 very 与 much 的分工：very 修饰原级，much 修饰比较级。
goal: 能按语义选对副词并放对位置。

sentences.en: The rabbit sits down and opens the little account book.
sentences.zh: 兔子坐下来，打开小小的账本。

sentences.en: The rabbit writes every number carefully.
sentences.zh: 兔子仔细地写下每个数字。
sentences.note: 方式副词：carefully 修饰动词 writes——方式副词站动词后、句末最稳

sentences.en: The numbers are very clear now.
sentences.zh: 数字现在非常清楚。
sentences.note: 程度副词：very 修饰原级 clear——very 只修饰原级

sentences.en: The wolf waits quietly outside.
sentences.zh: 狼在门外安静地等着。
sentences.note: 方式 + 地点副词：quietly（方式）、outside（地点）都站动词后句末——方式在前，地点在后

sentences.en: The wolf comes back before dinner.
sentences.zh: 狼在晚饭前回来了。

sentences.en: Luckily, the numbers are right.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，数字都对。
sentences.note: 句子副词：Luckily 给整句定调——站句首、加逗号，不修饰某个词

sentences.en: Suddenly, the wolf knocks at the door.
sentences.zh: 突然，狼敲响了门。

sentences.en: Finally, the little shop is clean and ready.
sentences.zh: 最后，小店干净又齐整。

sentences.en: The rabbit opens the door with a happy smile.
sentences.zh: 兔子带着开心的笑打开门。

sentences.en: The wolf is much happier than before.
sentences.zh: 狼比从前开心多了。
sentences.note: very 与 much：much 修饰比较级 happier——very 只修饰原级

sentences.en: Mother sheep comes with a big bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 绵羊妈妈带着一大袋面粉来了。

sentences.en: The friends eat the delicious soup together.
sentences.zh: 朋友们一起喝美味的汤。

sentences.en: The little shop is warm and friendly.
sentences.zh: 小店温暖又友好。

sentences.en: The wolf waves goodbye at the door.
sentences.zh: 狼在门口挥手告别。

sentences.en: That is the story of the busy little shop.
sentences.zh: 这就是那家忙碌小店的故事。

vocab.example: The rabbit sits down and opens the little account book.
The rabbit writes every number carefully.
The rabbit writes every number carefully.
The wolf waits quietly outside.
Luckily, the numbers are right.
Suddenly, the wolf knocks at the door.
Finally, the little shop is clean and ready.
Luckily, the numbers are right.
The numbers are very clear now.
The friends eat the delicious soup together.

notes.rule:
**规则**：副词按语义分类，站位各不相同。**方式副词**（quickly、carefully）站动词后、**句末最稳**（`The rabbit writes carefully.`）；**程度副词**（very、quite）站**被修饰词前**（`very clear`，enough 例外在后）；**时间副词**（now、finally）多站句末，也可站句首；**地点副词**（here、outside）站动词后 / 句末；**频度副词**（always、often）站位见 U04L28 的「系后实前」。**句子副词**（Luckily、Finally、However）不修饰某个词，而是给**整句**定调——站**句首、加逗号**（`Luckily, the numbers are right.`）。**very 与 much 的分工**：very 修饰**原级**与 -ly 副词（`very clear`、`very quickly`），much 修饰**比较级**（`much happier`、`much better`）——不说 very better。多个状语同现按「**方式 → 地点 → 时间**」排队（`The rabbit works carefully in the shop every day.`）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `Luckily, the numbers are right.` —— 句子副词站句首加逗号，给整件事定调
✅ `much happier / very clear` —— much 修饰比较级，very 修饰原级
❌ `very happier` —— very 不修饰比较级，要改成 much happier

practice.stem: 「Luckily, the numbers are right.」中 Luckily 的岗位是：
options: 修饰 numbers 的形容词
句子副词，给整句定调，站句首加逗号
修饰 are 的程度副词
practice.explanation: **B**。Luckily 不修饰某个词，是给整句定调的句子副词——站句首、加逗号。

practice.stem: 下面哪句的 very / much 用对了？
practice.explanation: **B**。much 修饰比较级（much better）；A、C 的 very 不修饰比较级，D 的 much happy 该用 very happy。

practice.template: The rabbit writes the numbers with care. → The rabbit writes the numbers ______.
practice.explanation: **carefully**。with care（方式短语）换成方式副词 carefully，站动词 writes 后、句末。

practice.template: The wolf is friendly to everyone.（整句定调「幸运的是」）→ ______, the wolf is friendly to everyone.
practice.explanation: **Luckily**。「幸运的是」的句子副词是 Luckily，站句首、加逗号。

practice.template: The wolf is happier than before. → The wolf is ______ happier than before.
practice.explanation: **much（或 even / far / a little）**。比较级 happier 前用 much（……得多）；even / far / a little 站比较级前也合语法；very 只修饰原级。

practice.prompt: 用「方式副词 + 动词」「句子副词放句首」「much + 比较级」三种各写一句（共 3 句）。
sample: The rabbit writes carefully.
Luckily, the wolf is friendly.
The wolf is much happier than before.

quiz.stem: 「The rabbit writes every number carefully.」中 carefully 是什么副词？
quiz.explanation: **A**。carefully 说明「怎么写」，修饰动词 writes——方式副词，站句末最稳。

quiz.stem: 句子副词给整句定调，站句首、加 ______。
quiz.explanation: **逗号**。句子副词站句首并用逗号隔开：Luckily, the numbers are right.

quiz.stem: very 与 much 的分工，哪句是正确的？
quiz.explanation: **B**。much + 比较级（much happier）；very + 原级，A、C 用 very 修饰比较级错，D 用 much 修饰原级错。

quiz.stem: 「狼安静地在门外等着。」= The wolf waits quietly ______.（地点副词站方式副词后面）
quiz.explanation: **outside**。quietly（方式）在前、outside（地点）在后，都站动词后、句末——多个状语按「方式 → 地点 → 时间」排队。

quiz.stem: 「The little shop is always busy.」中 always 站在：（复习 U04L28：副词的站位公式）
quiz.explanation: **B**。「系后实前」：busy 是表语，always 站系动词 is 后面（U04L28）。

quiz.stem: good 的比较级是 ______。（复习 U04L26：比较级与最高级的变化规则）
quiz.explanation: **better**。good 的不规则比较级：good → better → best（U04L26）。

title: 介词：时间 at / on / in 口诀
objective: 装修的日子定下来了，接下来是约时间：几号开工、几点送材料、每天干多久。英语里时间短语前挂哪个介词，只看「尺度」：时刻 / 时间点用 at，具体某天用 on，较长时段用 in——记住口诀「点钟 at、某天 on、月年 in」。另外两笔账要分清：in + 一段时间 = 将来还要多久（`in two days` = 两天后），for + 一段时间 = 持续多久（`for six hours` = 长达六小时）。
goal: 能给时间短语选对介词，不再靠语感蒙。

sentences.en: The rabbit paints Carrot Home in May.
sentences.zh: 兔子在五月给 Carrot Home 刷新漆。
sentences.note: 「月年 in」：月份是长时段，用 in——口诀「点钟 at、某天 on、月年 in」

sentences.en: The friendly wolf comes to help.
sentences.zh: 友好的狼前来帮忙。

sentences.en: They start at eight o'clock on Monday.
sentences.zh: 他们周一八点开工。
sentences.note: 时刻用 at、具体某天用 on：at eight o'clock on Monday——「点钟 at、某天 on」

sentences.en: The old sign comes down, and a new green one goes up.
sentences.zh: 旧招牌取下来，一块新的绿招牌挂上去。

sentences.en: The little shop looks bright and new again.
sentences.zh: 小店看起来又明亮又崭新。

sentences.en: The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he finishes the last wall.
sentences.zh: 狼上午刷墙，周五上午他刷完最后一面墙。
sentences.note: in the morning vs on Friday morning：泛指早晨用 in，具体某天的早晨跟着日子用 on

sentences.en: He works for six hours every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天干六个小时。
sentences.note: for + 一段时间 = 持续多久：for six hours 答「干了多久」，「还要多久」才用 in

sentences.en: Then the tired wolf has a long rest.
sentences.zh: 然后疲惫的狼好好歇一歇。

sentences.en: The little sheep watches quietly at the door.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊在门口安静地看着。

sentences.en: The new shelves arrive in two days.
sentences.zh: 新货架两天后送到。
sentences.note: in + 一段时间 = 还要多久（将来）：in two days = 两天后到，不是「持续两天」

sentences.en: The bear from town brings them at noon.
sentences.zh: 镇上的熊中午把它们送来。

sentences.en: The rabbit opens the shop again on Monday.
sentences.zh: 兔子周一重新开门。

sentences.en: "Come back at noon on Monday," says the rabbit with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 「周一中午回来吧，」兔子笑着说。

vocab.example: The rabbit paints Carrot Home in May.
They start at eight o'clock on Monday.
The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he finishes the last wall.
The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he finishes the last wall.
The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he finishes the last wall.
Then the tired wolf has a long rest.
The new shelves arrive in two days.
The bear from town brings them at noon.
The bear from town brings them at noon.
The bear from town brings them at noon.

notes.rule:
**规则**：时间介词只看「时间的尺度」，口诀：**点钟 at、某天 on、月年 in**。**at** 管时刻 / 时间点（`at eight o'clock`、`at noon`）；**on** 管具体某一天（`on Monday`），具体某天的早晨 / 傍晚也跟着用 on（`on Friday morning`）；**in** 管较长时段（`in May`、`in the morning`——泛指「早上」这种时段）。另两条账：**in + 一段时间** = 将来「还要多久」（`in two days` = 两天后）；**for + 一段时间** = 「持续多久」（`for six hours` = 长达六小时）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `at eight o'clock on Monday in May` —— 小时间在前、大时间在后：点钟 at → 某天 on → 月年 in
❌ `in Monday / on 2026 / in Friday morning` —— 某天误用 in、年份误用 on、具体某天的早晨误用 in
✅ `The shelves arrive in two days. / The wolf works for six hours.` —— in + 时段 = 还要多久；for + 时段 = 持续多久

practice.stem: 「They start at eight o'clock on Monday.」里为什么用 at 和 on？
options: at 管时刻，on 管具体某天
at 管某天，on 管时刻
at 和 on 都管月份
practice.explanation: **A**。at 管时刻 / 时间点（eight o'clock），on 管具体某天（Monday）——口诀「点钟 at、某天 on」。

practice.stem: 「The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he finishes the wall.」为什么一个 in 一个 on？
options: in the morning 泛指早晨时段，on Friday morning 是具体某天的早晨
in the morning 是错误用法
practice.explanation: **B**。in the morning 的 morning 是泛指的早晨时段，用 in；on Friday morning 是具体某天（周五）的早晨，跟着日子用 on。

practice.template: The rabbit paints in May. → The rabbit paints ______ Monday.
practice.explanation: **on**。Monday 是具体某天，用 on——「某天 on」。

practice.template: The wolf works on Friday. → The wolf works ______ the morning.
practice.explanation: **in**。the morning 泛指早晨这段长时段，用 in——「月年 in」同理。

practice.template: The bear comes ______ noon ______ Monday with the shelves.
practice.explanation: **at；on**。noon 是时刻点用 at，Monday 是具体某天用 on——小时间挂在大日子前。

practice.prompt: 用 at / on / in 各写一句：一句写时刻、一句写具体某天、一句写月份或年份。
sample: I get up at seven o'clock.
The shop opens on Monday.
The rabbit paints the house in May.
practice.criteria: 时间介词与时间尺度对上即可

quiz.stem: 「八点钟」= ______ eight o'clock.（时间点用的介词）
quiz.explanation: **at**。eight o'clock 是时刻 / 时间点——「点钟 at」。

quiz.stem:
「The rabbit paints the shop ______ May.」横线处填什么？
- A. at
- B. on
- C. in
- D. to
quiz.explanation: **C**。May 是月份，较长时段用 in——「月年 in」。

quiz.stem: The new shelves arrive ______ two days.（「两天后」用的介词）
quiz.explanation: **in**。in + 一段时间 = 将来「还要多久」：in two days = 两天后。

quiz.stem: 「他每天干六个小时」（持续多久）该怎么说？
options: He works at six hours every day.
He works on six hours every day.
He works in six hours every day.
He works for six hours every day.
quiz.explanation: **D**。for + 一段时间 = 持续多久：for six hours = 长达六小时；in six hours 是「六小时后」，意思不同。

quiz.stem: 「The new wall looks very bright.」中的 very 是什么用法？（复习 U04L29：very 与 much 的分工）
options: 修饰比较级，相当于 much
quiz.explanation: **A**。very 修饰原级形容词 bright；修饰比较级要用 much（much bigger）（U04L29）。

quiz.stem: This wall is ______ bigger than that one.（「大得多」用的修饰词）（复习 U04L27：比较级 + than）
quiz.explanation: **much**。「大得多」= much bigger，much 修饰比较级（U04L27）。

title: 介词：地点与方位（点、面、体）
objective: 墙刷好了，接下来是摆放：桌子放哪、灯放哪、箱子放哪。位置说不说得清，全靠地点介词：at = 点（具体位置 / 小地点）、on = 面（表面上）、in = 体（内部空间）。东西之间的相对位置用方位介词：`in front of`（在……前面）、`behind`（在……后面）、`opposite`（在……对面）。还有一对易混：`in the house` 看「屋里」，`at the house` 看「房子那儿」。
goal: 能用介词把东西的位置说清楚。

sentences.en: The rabbit puts the new table in the shop.
sentences.zh: 兔子把新桌子放进店里。

sentences.en: The little lamp is on the table, the green box is at the door, and the carrots are in the box.
sentences.zh: 小台灯在桌上，绿箱子在门边，胡萝卜在箱子里。
sentences.note: 点面体：on the table（面）、at the door（点）、in the box（体）——空间感不同，介词跟着换

sentences.en: Two new pictures hang on the wall.
sentences.zh: 两幅新画挂在墙上。

sentences.en: The little sheep puts her little bag on the floor.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊把她的小袋子放在地板上。

sentences.en: The shop looks warm and bright.
sentences.zh: 小店看起来温暖又明亮。

sentences.en: The old shelf stands in front of the window, and a small table is behind the door.
sentences.zh: 旧货架立在窗前，门后放着一张小桌子。
sentences.note: in front of / behind：in front of = 在……（外部的）前面，behind = 在……后面——一对反义方位词

sentences.en: The bear's shop is opposite Carrot Home.
sentences.zh: 熊的铺子在 Carrot Home 对面。
sentences.note: opposite：在……对面——两家店隔着街面对面，不在同一侧

sentences.en: The rabbit puts the new bowls on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 兔子把新碗放到架子上。

sentences.en: The little sheep looks at the pictures and smiles.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊看着画，笑了。

sentences.en: Now every corner of the little shop is clean and warm.
sentences.zh: 现在小店的每个角落都干净又温暖。

sentences.en: The rabbit works in the house all day.
sentences.zh: 兔子整天在屋里干活。
sentences.note: in the house vs at the house：in 强调「在屋里」的内部空间，at 强调「在房子那儿」的位置点

sentences.en: The wolf comes to the house at noon.
sentences.zh: 狼中午来到房子这儿。

sentences.en: They put everything in the right place and close the door.
sentences.zh: 他们把每样东西放回原位，关上门。

vocab.example: The rabbit puts the new table in the shop.
The little lamp is on the table, the green box is at the door, and the carrots are in the box.
Two new pictures hang on the wall.
The little sheep puts her little bag on the floor.
The old shelf stands in front of the window, and a small table is behind the door.
The bear's shop is opposite Carrot Home.
The rabbit works in the house all day.
Now every corner of the little shop is clean and warm.
The little lamp is on the table, the green box is at the door, and the carrots are in the box.
The rabbit puts the new bowls on the shelf.
The little sheep puts her little bag on the floor.

notes.rule:
**规则**：地点介词 at / on / in 按「空间感」分：**at = 点**（具体位置 / 小地点：`at the door`）、**on = 面**（表面上、线上：`on the table`、`on the wall`）、**in = 体**（内部 / 大范围：`in the shop`、`in the box`）。方位介词把两个东西的相对位置说清：`in front of`（在……前面，指外部的前面）、`behind`（在……后面）、`opposite`（在……对面）。易混辨析：`in the house` 强调「在屋里」的内部空间，`at the house` 强调「在房子那儿」的位置点——多一个 in，看的东西不同。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The lamp is on the table, and the carrots are in the box.` —— 面上用 on、内部用 in
❌ `The wolf waits in the door. / The lamp stands in the table.` —— 门是「点」要用 at，桌面是「面」要用 on，in the table 说成了「灯在桌子里面」（stands at the table 是「站在桌旁」，语义又不同）
✅ `in the house（在屋里）/ at the house（在房子那儿）` —— in 看内部空间，at 看位置点

practice.stem: 「The little lamp is on the table.」为什么用 on？
options: table 是「面」，放在表面上用 on
practice.explanation: **A**。table 的表面是「面」，放在表面上用 on——点 at、面 on、体 in。

practice.stem: 「The bear's shop is opposite Carrot Home.」的 opposite 是什么意思？
practice.explanation: **C**。opposite = 在……对面：熊的铺子和 Carrot Home 隔街相望。

practice.template: The carrots are in the box. → The lamp is ______ the table.
practice.explanation: **on**。the table 是「面」，放在表面上用 on——点 at、面 on、体 in。

practice.template: The shelf is in front of the window. → The small table is ______ the door.
hints: in front of 的反义方位
practice.explanation: **behind**。in front of 是「前面」，反义方位词是 behind「后面」。

practice.template: The wolf waits at the door. → The rabbit works ______ the house.
practice.explanation: **in**。the house 是内部空间（「体」），在屋里用 in。

practice.prompt: 用 at / on / in + 地点名词各写一句（点、面、体各一），再用 opposite 或 behind 写一句，说清你房间里东西的位置。
sample: The lamp is on the table.
The bag is at the door.
The carrots are in the box.
practice.criteria: 点 / 面 / 体对上即可

quiz.stem: 下面哪组「介词 + 名词」搭配全对？
options: at the table / on the door / in the point
at the door / on the table / in the box
in the door / at the table / on the box
on the door / in the table / at the box
quiz.explanation: **B**。at the door（点）、on the table（面）、in the box（体）——点、面、体各归各。

quiz.stem: 「在……（外部的）前面」的固定短语：______ ______ ______ the window（窗前）。
quiz.explanation: **in；front；of**。「在……（外部的）前面」= in front of，三个词整体记。

quiz.stem: 「in the house」和「at the house」的区别是什么？
options: in 强调「在屋里」的内部空间，at 强调「在房子那儿」的位置点
in the house 是错误用法
at the house 只能用于时间
quiz.explanation: **A**。in the house 强调「在屋里」的内部空间，at the house 强调「在房子那儿」的位置点。

quiz.stem: A small table is ______ the door.（在门后面，in front of 的反义方位）
quiz.explanation: **behind**。behind = 在……后面，和 in front of 正好相反。

quiz.stem: 「The wolf paints in the morning, and on Friday morning he works.」为什么一个 in 一个 on？（复习 U04L30：时间介词 at / on / in）
options: in the morning 泛指早晨时段，on Friday morning 是具体某天的早晨
quiz.explanation: **A**。in the morning 泛指早晨时段用 in，on Friday morning 是具体某天的早晨用 on（U04L30）。

quiz.stem: The wolf works ______（辛苦地）all day.（hard / hardly 辨析）（复习 U04L28：常见陷阱）
quiz.explanation: **hard**。hard 作副词 = 努力地 / 辛苦地；hardly 是「几乎不」，意思完全不同（U04L28）。

title: 短语动词：可分型 vs 动词 + 介词型
objective: 店里的活儿是一串动作：找招牌、照看生意、拎袋子、等客人——这些「动词 + 介词」拼出来的短语动词，意思不等于两个词相加，要当一个词整体记（`look for` = 寻找、`give up` = 放弃、`arrive at` = 到达）。还有一条位置铁律：pick up / give up 这类短语动词的宾语是代词时，必须放在动词和介词中间（`pick them up`，不写 `pick up them`）。
goal: 能把高频动词短语当一个词来用和记。

sentences.en: The wolf looks for the old sign behind the shop.
sentences.zh: 狼在店后找旧招牌。
sentences.note: look for「寻找」：动词 + 介词当一个新动词整体记，不拆成 look + for 猜意思

sentences.en: The rabbit looks after the little shop every day.
sentences.zh: 兔子每天照看小店。

sentences.en: The little sheep looks at the new pictures on the wall.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊看着墙上的新画。

sentences.en: The bear arrives at the shop at noon.
sentences.zh: 熊中午到了店里。
sentences.note: arrive at「到达」：arrive at + 小地点、arrive in + 大地方——at / in 跟着 arrive 整体记

sentences.en: He brings two bags of fresh carrots.
sentences.zh: 他带来两袋新鲜的胡萝卜。

sentences.en: The bags are heavy, but the wolf picks them up.
sentences.zh: 袋子很沉，但狼把它们拎了起来。
sentences.note: 代词必中置：pick them up——代词宾语放在动词和介词中间，不写 pick up them

sentences.en: He puts them on the big shelf.
sentences.zh: 他把它们放到大架子上。

sentences.en: The little sheep waits for her mother at the door.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊在门口等妈妈。

sentences.en: The rabbit listens to the bear and thinks of a new idea.
sentences.zh: 兔子听熊说话，想到一个新主意。

sentences.en: She writes it down on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 她把主意写在一张纸上。

sentences.en: Sometimes the work is hard, but nobody gives up.
sentences.zh: 有时活儿很难，但没有谁放弃。
sentences.note: give up「放弃」：give up + 名词，宾语是代词时中置 give it up——短语动词整体记

sentences.en: At six, the wolf turns off the lamp and closes the door.
sentences.zh: 六点钟，狼关上灯、关上门。

sentences.en: The little shop opens again the next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天小店又开门了。

vocab.example: The wolf looks for the old sign behind the shop.
The rabbit looks after the little shop every day.
The bear arrives at the shop at noon.
The bags are heavy, but the wolf picks them up.
Sometimes the work is hard, but nobody gives up.
The little sheep waits for her mother at the door.
The rabbit listens to the bear and thinks of a new idea.
The rabbit listens to the bear and thinks of a new idea.
At six, the wolf turns off the lamp and closes the door.
The rabbit listens to the bear and thinks of a new idea.
The wolf looks for the old sign behind the shop.

notes.rule:
**规则**：**动词 + 介词 = 一个新的动词**，意思不等于两个词相加，要**整体记**。常见 20 组：`look at`、`look for`、`look after`、`look like`、`listen to`、`wait for`、`think of`、`arrive at`、`give up`、`find out`、`get up`、`wake up`、`pick up`、`put on`、`take off`、`turn on`、`turn off`、`come back`、`go out`、`work out`。**宾语位置先分两类**：**可分型**（pick up / give up / turn off 这类「动词 + 副词小品词」）——名词宾语放短语后（`pick up the bags`）或中间（`pick the bags up`）都可以；**动词 + 介词型**（look after / listen to / wait for / arrive at）——宾语只能放整个短语后（`look after the shop`），不能拆开插词（`looks the shop after` ❌）。**代词宾语**：可分型必须放中间（`pick them up`），这叫「代词必中置」；动词 + 介词型照旧跟在整个短语后（`wait for her`、`listen to me`）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The wolf picks up the bags. / The wolf picks the bags up.` —— 可分型的名词宾语放后面或中间都行
✅ `The wolf picks them up. / The rabbit gives it up.` —— 可分型的代词宾语必须放在动词和介词中间
❌ `The wolf picks up them. / The rabbit looks the shop after.` —— 可分型的代词不能跟在整个短语后；look after 是整体，别拆开插词

practice.stem: 「look for」为什么要当一个词记？
options: look 和 for 各有意思，加起来就是「寻找」
动词 + 介词组成新动词，意思不等于两个词相加
look for 只能放在句首
practice.explanation: **B**。look for =「寻找」，是「动词 + 介词」组成的新动词，意思不等于 look 加 for，要整体记。

practice.stem: 「The wolf picks them up.」里的 them 为什么放在中间？
options: 代词宾语必须放在动词和介词中间（代词必中置）
practice.explanation: **A**。代词宾语必须放在动词和介词中间（代词必中置）：pick them up，不能 pick up them。

practice.template: The rabbit looks for the sign. → The rabbit looks ______ the little shop every day.
practice.explanation: **after**。「照顾」= look after，短语动词整体记，别拆开插词。

practice.template: The wolf picks up the bags. → The wolf picks ______ up.
practice.explanation: **them**。代词宾语中置：pick them up（bags = them）。

practice.template: The bear arrives at the shop at noon. → The bear ______ the shop at noon.
practice.explanation: **arrives at**。「到达」= arrive at + 小地点；主语是第三人称单数，arrive 加 s。

practice.prompt: 用 look for / look after / give up 各造一句，其中至少一句把代词宾语放在中间（如 give it up）。
sample: The rabbit looks for the sign.
The wolf looks after the shop.
The rabbit gives it up.
practice.criteria: 短语动词整体用、代词中置对即可

quiz.stem: 哪句的代词宾语位置是对的？
quiz.explanation: **B**。代词宾语放动词和介词中间：pick them up。

quiz.stem: 「寻找」的短语动词是 look ______。
quiz.explanation: **for**。「寻找」= look for。

quiz.stem:
「The bear arrives ______ the shop.」横线处填什么？（小地点）
- A. in
- B. at
- C. on
- D. to
quiz.explanation: **B**。arrive at + 小地点（the shop）；arrive in + 大地方（如北京）。

quiz.stem: give ______ up（「它」必须放在动词和介词中间）。
quiz.explanation: **it**。代词必中置：give it up，不写 give up it。

quiz.stem: 「The lamp is on the table.」的 on 是什么空间感？（复习 U04L31：地点介词点、面、体）
quiz.explanation: **B**。on the table 的 table 是「面」，放在表面上用 on——点 at、面 on、体 in（U04L31）。

quiz.stem: 「Luckily, the wolf finishes the wall on Friday.」中的 Luckily 是什么？（复习 U04L29：句子副词与副词分类）
options: 句子副词，修饰整句，可放句首
修饰 wolf 的形容词
quiz.explanation: **A**。Luckily 是句子副词，修饰整句，可放句首（U04L29）。

title: 数词：基数、序数与编号
objective: 装修完了要记账：多少根胡萝卜、多少只碗、订单第几号。数词有两套：基数词数数量（one … hundred），序数词排顺序（first / second / third，前面一般加 the）。房间号、页码、订单号这类编号也有固定读法：`Room 101` = `Room one o one`、`page 20` = `page twenty`——编号用「名词 + 基数词」正序读，和「the + 序数词 + 名词」是同一回事。
goal: 能正确说出数字、顺序与编号。

sentences.en: The rabbit counts the money at the big table.
sentences.zh: 兔子在大桌旁数钱。

sentences.en: There are three hundred carrots in the green box.
sentences.zh: 绿箱子里有三百根胡萝卜。
sentences.note: hundred 前有具体数字不加 s：three hundred——模糊的「成百上千」才用 hundreds of

sentences.en: The wolf counts twenty-one bowls on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 狼数着架子上的二十一只碗。
sentences.note: 两位数：整十 + 连字符 + 个位——twenty-one，不是 twenty one

sentences.en: The little sheep writes the numbers on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊把数字写在一张纸上。

sentences.en: The numbers are clear and easy to read.
sentences.zh: 数字清楚好认。

sentences.en: It is the first big order of Carrot Home.
sentences.zh: 这是 Carrot Home 第一笔大订单。
sentences.note: 序数词前一般加 the：the first order——one → first、two → second、three → third

sentences.en: The bear comes on the second day.
sentences.zh: 熊第二天来。

sentences.en: On the third day, the rabbit pays for everything.
sentences.zh: 第三天，兔子付清了所有钱。

sentences.en: The little sheep is very happy, and the wolf smiles too.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊很开心，狼也笑了。

sentences.en: The new bowls are on page 20 of the catalog.
sentences.zh: 新碗在目录的第 20 页。
sentences.note: page 20 = page twenty：页码用「page + 基数词」正序读

sentences.en: The bear's little office is Room 101 in town.
sentences.zh: 熊的小办公室在镇上的 101 房间。
sentences.note: Room 101 = Room one o one：房间号逐位读，0 读作 o，前面不加 the

sentences.en: The order number is 302.
sentences.zh: 订单号是 302。

sentences.en: "This is a good day," says the rabbit.
sentences.zh: 「今天是个好日子，」兔子说。

vocab.example: There are three hundred carrots in the green box.
The little sheep writes the numbers on a piece of paper.
The new bowls are on page 20 of the catalog.
The new bowls are on page 20 of the catalog.
The bear's little office is Room 101 in town.
On the third day, the rabbit pays for everything.
The bear comes on the second day.
On the third day, the rabbit pays for everything.
The rabbit counts the money at the big table.
The rabbit counts the money at the big table.
It is the first big order of Carrot Home.

notes.rule:
**规则**：数词两套。**基数词**表数量：1–12 独立背，13–19 是 -teen，整十是 -ty；两位数 = 整十 + 连字符 + 个位（`twenty-one`）；百位 = `three hundred`——**hundred 前有具体数字时不加 s**，只有模糊的「成百上千」才说 `hundreds of`。**序数词**表顺序：one → `first`、two → `second`、three → `third`，其余多加 -th，前面**一般加 the**：`the first order`。**编号读法**：「名词 + 基数词」正序（`page 20` = `page twenty`、`Room 101` = `Room one o one`）=「the + 序数词 + 名词」（`the twentieth page`）；房间号 / 编号逐位读，0 读字母 o 的音，编号前**不加 the**。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `three hundred carrots / twenty-one bowls` —— 具体数字后 hundred 不加 s；两位数加连字符
❌ `three hundreds carrots / twenty one bowls` —— hundred 加 s 错；两位数漏连字符错
✅ `page 20 = page twenty / Room 101 = Room one o one` —— 编号「名词 + 基数词」正序读，0 读 o

practice.stem: 「three hundred carrots」的 hundred 为什么不加 s？
options: 前面有具体数字时不加 s，只有 hundreds of 这种模糊表达才加
practice.explanation: **B**。hundred 前有具体数字时不加 s：three hundred；模糊的「成百上千」才说 hundreds of。

practice.stem: 「the first order」中的 first 是什么？
options: 序数词，前面加 the 表顺序
practice.explanation: **B**。first 是序数词表顺序，前面一般加 the：the first order（one → first）。

practice.template: The wolf counts twenty-one bowls. → The wolf counts ______ bowls.
practice.explanation: **thirty-two**。两位数 = 整十 + 连字符 + 个位：thirty-two。

practice.template: It is the first order. → It is the ______ order.
practice.explanation: **second**。「第二」= second，序数词前加 the：the second order。

practice.template: The office is ______ 101, and the bowls are on ______ 20.
practice.explanation: **Room；page**。房间号用「Room + 基数词逐位读」，页码用「page + 基数词」。

practice.prompt: 写三句：一句用基数词数货物（含 hundred 或两位数），一句用序数词说顺序（the first / second / third），一句写编号（page 或 Room + 数字）。
sample: There are three hundred carrots.
The bear comes on the second day.
The bowls are on page 20.
practice.criteria: 基数 / 序数 / 编号用对即可

quiz.stem: one → ______（序数词「第一」）。
quiz.explanation: **first**。one 的序数词是 first（two → second、three → third）。

quiz.stem: 「Room 101」怎么读？
quiz.explanation: **B**。房间号逐位读，0 读字母 o 的音：Room one o one；编号前不加 the。

quiz.stem: 21 = twenty-one（整十 + 连字符 + 个位）：32 = ______。
quiz.explanation: **thirty-two**。32 = thirty-two：整十 thirty + 连字符 + 个位 two。

quiz.stem: 哪句是正确的？
quiz.explanation: **C**。具体数字后 hundred 不加 s、可数名词变复数：three hundred carrots。

quiz.stem: 「放弃它」该怎么说？（复习 U04L32：短语动词的宾语位置）
quiz.explanation: **B**。代词宾语必中置：give it up（U04L32）。

quiz.stem: The bear arrives ______ noon.（时刻用的介词）（复习 U04L30：时间介词 at / on / in）
quiz.explanation: **at**。noon 是时刻点，用 at——「点钟 at」（U04L30）。

title: 数词：分数倍数与日期读法
objective: 最后一笔账是比价与报时：卖了几分之几、贵几倍、哪天几点开张。分数「基数（分子）+ 序数（分母），分子大于 1 分母加 s」（`two thirds`）；百分数 = 数字 + `percent`（不加 s）。倍数两倍固定用 `twice`、三倍及以上用「基数词 + `times`」。年份两位分组读、日期用序数词读、时刻顺读或用 past / to 逆读。
goal: 能读写分数、倍数、日期与时刻。

sentences.en: On market day, two thirds of the carrots are sold before noon.
sentences.zh: 集日上，三分之二的胡萝卜在中午前卖完。
sentences.note: two thirds：分子大于 1 时分母加 s——one third、two thirds、two fifths

sentences.en: The rabbit keeps one third of them for the soup.
sentences.zh: 兔子留下三分之一做汤。

sentences.en: Fifty percent of the customers choose the carrot soup.
sentences.zh: 一半顾客选了胡萝卜汤。
sentences.note: fifty percent：百分数 = 数字 + percent，percent 不加 s

sentences.en: The little sheep helps the rabbit count the money.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊帮兔子数钱。

sentences.en: The new basket is twice as expensive as the old one.
sentences.zh: 新篮子是旧篮子的两倍贵。
sentences.note: twice as … as：倍数词放在 as … as 前面——A 是 B 的两倍……

sentences.en: The wolf runs three times faster than the little sheep.
sentences.zh: 狼比小绵羊跑得快三倍。

sentences.en: The new table is twice the size of the old one.
sentences.zh: 新桌子是旧桌子的两倍大。

sentences.en: They put the new baskets on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 他们把新篮子放到架子上。

sentences.en: Carrot Home first opened on May 1st, 1998.
sentences.zh: Carrot Home 最初在 1998 年 5 月 1 日开张。
sentences.note: May 1st, 1998 = May (the) first, nineteen ninety-eight：日期用序数词读，年份两位两位分组读

sentences.en: The rabbit leaves at a quarter to four, and the bear arrives at half past four.
sentences.zh: 兔子差一刻四点离开，熊四点半到。
sentences.note: 3:45 = a quarter to four、4:30 = half past four：差一刻用 a quarter to，几点半用 half past

sentences.en: The little sheep writes the date and the time in her little book.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊把日期和时间记在小本子上。

sentences.en: "This is a good year," says the rabbit with a smile.
sentences.zh: 「这是个好年头，」兔子笑着说。

vocab.example: On market day, two thirds of the carrots are sold before noon.
Fifty percent of the customers choose the carrot soup.
The new basket is twice as expensive as the old one.
The new basket is twice as expensive as the old one.
The new table is twice the size of the old one.
The little sheep writes the date and the time in her little book.
The rabbit leaves at a quarter to four, and the bear arrives at half past four.
The little sheep writes the date and the time in her little book.
Fifty percent of the customers choose the carrot soup.
"This is a good year," says the rabbit with a smile.
Fifty percent of the customers choose the carrot soup.

notes.rule:
**规则**：**分数**：分子用基数词、分母用序数词；**分子 ≥ 2 时分母加 s**：`one third`、`two thirds`、`two fifths`。**百分数**：数字 + `percent`，percent 不加 s：`fifty percent`。**倍数**：两倍固定 `twice`、三倍及以上用「基数词 + `times`」，三种结构等价：**倍数 + as … as**（`twice as expensive as`）、**倍数 + 比较级 + than**（`three times faster than`）、**倍数 + the + 名词 + of**（`twice the size of`）——倍数词一律放在 as … as 前面。**年月日时刻**：日期用序数词读（`May 1st = May (the) first`），年份两位两位分组读（1998 = `nineteen ninety-eight`）；时刻顺读（3:45 = `three forty-five`），逆读分 ≤ 30 用 past、> 30 用 to（`twenty-five past three`、`a quarter to four`），几点半固定用 `half past`。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `one third / two fifths / fifty percent` —— 分子大于 1 分母加 s；percent 不加 s
❌ `two fifth / as twice fast as / two percents` —— 分母漏 s、倍数词位置错、percent 加 s 都是错的
✅ `twice as expensive as = twice the size of / a quarter to four` —— 倍数结构等价；差一刻用 a quarter to

practice.stem: 「two thirds」的分母为什么加 s？
options: 分子大于 1 时分母（序数词）变复数
practice.explanation: **B**。分数的分母是序数词，分子大于 1 时分母变复数：two thirds、two fifths。

practice.stem: 倍数词在 as … as 结构里放哪里？
practice.explanation: **B**。倍数词放在 as … as 前面：twice as fast as；写成 as twice fast as 是错的。

practice.template: one third → two ______.
practice.explanation: **thirds**。分子 two 大于 1，分母加 s：two thirds。

practice.template: The old basket is cheap. → The new basket is ______ as expensive as the old one.
practice.explanation: **twice**。两倍固定用 twice：twice as expensive as……

practice.template: 3:45 = three forty-five = ______ to four.
practice.explanation: **a quarter**。3:45 = a quarter to four：差一刻到四点，to + 下一个钟点。

practice.prompt: 写三句：一句用分数（如 two thirds）说数量，一句用倍数（twice 或 three times）比两样东西，一句写一个日期或时刻（用序数词或 past / to）。
sample: Two thirds of the carrots are gone.
The wolf is twice as tall as the rabbit.
The shop opens on May 1st.
practice.criteria: 分数 / 倍数 / 日期时刻用对即可

quiz.stem: 五分之一 = one ______（分子是 1 时分母不加 s）。
quiz.explanation: **fifth**。分子是 1 时分母不加 s：one fifth（五分之一）。

quiz.stem: 「50%」的英文是哪一种？
quiz.explanation: **B**。百分数 = 数字 + percent，percent 不加 s：fifty percent。

quiz.stem: A is ______ as heavy as B.（A 是 B 的两倍重）
quiz.explanation: **twice**。两倍固定用 twice，倍数词放在 as … as 前面。

quiz.stem: 3:45 的逆读是哪一种？
quiz.explanation: **C**。3:45 的分针超过 30，逆读用「a quarter to + 下一个钟点」= a quarter to four。

quiz.stem: 「第一笔订单」该怎么说？（复习 U04L33：序数词与 the）
quiz.explanation: **A**。序数词前一般加 the：the first order（U04L33）。

quiz.stem: The bear's shop is ______ Carrot Home.（在……对面）（复习 U04L31：方位介词）
quiz.explanation: **opposite**。opposite = 在……对面（U04L31）。
